name: manual_89bc45
claim: An inbox sidecar with received_at and a matching byte count is this host's store record. It is not a sender result. A drop is delivered only when its own result says ok true, includes received_at, and the byte count matches the file.

decisions.notes: The 2026-11-15 inbox sidecars match bytes and have received_at, and every sidecar leaves ok null.

rationale: The 2026-11-15 inbox sidecars match bytes and have received_at, and every sidecar leaves ok null.
